beats.say: AI chatbots speed up work. But whatever you type into a public chatbot leaves the institution.
Citizens' names, ID numbers, phone numbers and official documents are never pasted into a public chatbot.

body.text: Put these complaints in a table:

beats.say: The service may store what you type, its staff may read it, or it may train its model on it.
If your institution has an approved tool, use it. Even there, type only what is needed.

scenes.prompt: Can you type this into a chatbot or not?

body.text: Make this sentence more polite: "Dear colleagues, the meeting moves to tomorrow."

cards.explain: Nothing secret or personal. A chatbot is useful for ordinary text like this.

body.text: Put these 40 citizen complaints in a table: Məmmədova Günel, ID 7ML3Q2T, Nərimanov district...

cards.explain: Citizens' personal data must not leave the institution. Such work belongs only in an approved tool.

body.text: Edit this draft order labelled "For official use only": ...

cards.explain: A labelled document is not uploaded to a public service. The label means it stays inside the institution.

body.text: Write an Excel formula that joins two columns.

cards.explain: A general technical question leaks no information.

body.text: My script fails, fix it: server=10.20.4.15, password=Baki2026!

cards.explain: A password and an internal address are a ready key for an attacker. Remove such lines before pasting.

body.text: Write a short summary of the internal leave policy.

cards.explain: This is the institution's approved tool. Internal documents can be handled there.

scenes.title: Report with a chatbot
scenes.intro: You want a chatbot to help with a report. Make the right choice at every step.

steps.label: Upload your file and we will summarise it
steps.say: Whose data is in this file?

actions.label: Upload Vetendas_muracietleri.xlsx
actions.feedback: Data on 1,240 citizens went to an outside service. Tell the security team about it at once.

actions.label: Do not upload the file
actions.feedback: Right. A file with personal data is never uploaded to a public chatbot.

title.text: Use your chats to train the model?

body.text: Your chat history will be stored on the service's servers.

actions.label: Allow
actions.feedback: What you type stays with the service and may be used to train the model.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: Right. Turning training off helps, but still do not paste official information.

steps.label: İdarə Köməkçisi: the institution's approved tool

actions.label: Work on the report here
actions.feedback: Right. The approved tool keeps data inside the institution, still upload only what is needed.

actions.label: Go back to the public chatbot
actions.feedback: The institution has its own tool. Do not handle official information in a public service.

body.text: Under Article 14 of the Law, a citizen's request must be answered within 5 days.

actions.label: Check the source
actions.feedback: Right. A chatbot can be confidently wrong, so check the article and deadline in an official source.

actions.label: Copy it into the reply as is
actions.feedback: This article and deadline may be made up. An official reply must not contain unchecked facts.

scenes.prompt: What must be removed from this prompt before sending?

body.text: Write a reply to this request.

spots.label: Name and ID number
spots.explain: A citizen's identity must not go to a public service. If needed, replace the name with "Citizen A".

spots.label: Phone number
spots.explain: A phone number is personal data too. You do not need it to write a reply.

spots.label: Labelled text
spots.explain: Labelled documents are handled only in a system the institution has approved.

spots.label: Username and password
spots.explain: A password is never typed into any chatbot. If you did, change it at once.

question.prompt: You want to polish an official letter with a chatbot. What is the best way?

options.label: I paste the whole letter into a public chatbot
options.feedback: The names and details in the letter go to an outside service.

options.label: I use the approved tool and remove personal data
options.feedback: Right. An approved tool plus minimal data keeps the risk lowest.

options.label: I do it after work in a chatbot on my own phone
options.feedback: A different device still sends the data to an outside service.

scenes.explain: A simple rule: type into a public chatbot only text you could publish openly.

points: Never type citizens' data, labelled documents or passwords into a public chatbot.
Use the institution's approved tool, and type only the minimum there too.
Check a chatbot's answer in an official source, do not copy it as is.
